title: Quandale Dingle
blurb: Quandale Dingle — the name from a random screenshotted PC login that spiraled into one of the most absurd meme sagas ever created. The deep-fried voice, the impossible family lore, the escalating nonsense: this sound carries all of it. Play it as a non-sequitur, a greeting, or a tribute to the era when a stranger's Windows lock screen became folklore.
origin: From a screenshot of a PC login for 'Quandale Dingle', which became a deep-fried meme universe.
